correctness.rationale: Reconstructed closed-neighborhood parity exactly; all-degree parity from every pair and odd m is iff. All 3- and 5-edge cases are exhausted by handshaking and Eulerian cycle counts; the induced KG connectivity and disjoint labelled counts are checked. For n=5, 5 nonadjacent two-edge switches flip the sign class, yielding a 5-regular 6+6 bipartite crown. Python direct checker and independent C++ parity checker return the same minimum and counts at each n=5..10, including crown metric. Proof is symbolic for all n.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Tested general ordinary and total domination and k-tuple Kneser theorems as candidate stronger results. Their predicates differ: cardinal dominating and minimal total-dominating classifications neither assert nor entail uniform parity on all closed neighborhoods, and they do not enumerate star-plus-two-matchings and all-five-matchings as connected odd minima.
